Acute Medicine - Discharge Summary
Discharge Summary
Admission date/time: 22:09 on 07/03/2020
Discharge date/time: 11:22 on 15/03/2020
Diagnosis: COVID-19 pneumonia with type 1 respiratory failure, confirmed by SARS-CoV-2
PCR (swab taken 12:50 on 07/03/2020, positive result reported 20:24 on 07/03/2020).
Presenting complaint: Fever, cough and progressive breathlessness with severe hypoxia
(SpO2 <92% on air at 21:20 on 07/03/2020).
Hospital course: Admitted to the acute medical unit with rapid deterioration requiring
escalation to the intensive care unit at 18:07 on 08/03/2020 for CPAP respiratory support.
Respiratory failure progressed despite maximal non-invasive support and invasive ventilation was
commenced at 04:29 on 15/03/2020, with vasopressor support added for haemodynamic stability.
The discharge date recorded in the electronic system is 11:22 on 15/03/2020; this summary is issued to document
the critical care course and should be read alongside ICU nursing records, as the discharge time appears discordant with the clinical status described above.
Medications: Enoxaparin thromboprophylaxis and other critical care medications to be
reconciled against the current prescription chart by the receiving team.
Follow-up arrangements: Respiratory clinic review arranged within 2 weeks of discharge to
assess recovery, subject to confirmation of clinical status.
GP Actions: Please liaise with the hospital regarding current clinical status given the
complexity of this admission and arrange follow-up as appropriate once further information is
available.
